fusions.name: Startled Puff
fusions.desc: Bursts spores around you, dealing 4 nature damage to every enemy within 2.5 tiles and giving them Rot for 1 damage a second for 3 seconds. Your movement speed rises 15% for 2 seconds.

fusions.name: Wide Berth
fusions.desc: Launches a spore pod at a target up to 6 tiles away that deals 12 nature damage, rising to 1.6 times that at full reach. It knocks the target back 3 tiles, with a 50% chance to leave it [Diseased] for 6 seconds.

fusions.name: Run It Off
fusions.desc: Restores 3 health a second to you for 6 seconds, 10% more for every 100 paces you have run since you last used it, up to 50% more.

fusions.name: Quick to Knit
fusions.desc: When a blow that is not fire damages you, you regain 2 health a second for 4 seconds. Once every 8 seconds. Your dodge chance rises by 5%.
